messages:
Priya: quick heads-up: while testing handoffs i noticed a churn spike. new owner prefetches a prefix but the old owners demote path can still clear residency, leading to momentary dup-prefetches and a short-lived drop in tenant throughput. anyone seen this pattern? :wave:
Ben: yep, reproduced locally. pattern is: old demote cancels async prefetches, but some prefetch workers finish and race-writing residency. ends up as transient double-count and then hard-evict removes it -> small read gap
Liu: root cause seems to be lack of a shared prefetch session identity or generation check on completion. we never validate "is this prefetch still valid for current lease" before marking residency
Ana: two options: (A) attach a lightweight prefetch_ticket/nonce and drop completions that don't match current lease, or (B) make eviction idempotent via generation/tombstone so stale writes are ignored. prefer (A) for minimal metadata fwiw
Omar: (A) is cheap on write path but requires a header carried through the prefetch batches. (B) avoids rejecting work but complicates read-time checks. both have perf implications when hot prefixes are involved
Priya: proposal: implement a prefetch_ticket in stream header (ticket tied to lease_epoch). prefetch completion performs a single header-level validation against prefix.lease_epoch and ticket; if mismatch, completion returns early and emits metric. no per-key CASs
Liu: +1. add a metric kv.prefetch_ticket_rejects and a trace tag prefetch_ticket on completion spans. threshold alert if rejects > 0.5% of prefetches over 5m
Ana: for worst-case safety, we should also flip hard-evict to write an incremental evict_gen tombstone rather than blind delete. new owner will treat entries with older gen as invalid. avoids rare races where old owner deleted after new owner prefetched
Ben: note: evict_gen increases metadata per-prefix (4-8 bytes). read/prefetch path must check evict_gen cheaply. feasible but we'll want microbenchmarks to quantify cost on hot-read path
Omar: alternative hybrid: only write a tombstone when hard-evict follows a demote within Xs (i.e., when handoff freshness risk is high). saves metadata churn for normal evicts
Priya: good middle ground. short-term plan: implement prefetch_ticket header + reject metric; gate evict_gen tombstone behind feature flag and opt in for canary prefixes. owners: Ana implements ticketing + metrics + traces; Omar prototypes evict_gen tombstone and hybrid heuristic; Ben owns tests + microbench harness; Liu adds alerting and dashboard slices
Ben: tests Ill add: (1) prefetch completion with stale ticket should not write residency and should increment reject metric; (2) handoff where old owner hard-evicts with tombstone and new owner rejects stale prefetched residency; (3) perf regression smoke for top 100 prefixes
Liu: infra-bot: can we get a canary pool with tunables? i'd like knobs exposed: kv.prefetch.ticket_check=true, kv.eviction.gen_mode=hybrid, kv.eviction.gen_hybrid_window_s=60, kv.prefetch.reject_alert_pct=0.5, kv.handoff.sticky_backoff_s=30
infra-bot: received; will allocate a small canary cluster and attach config template for rollout
Ana: small implementation note: ensure prefetch streams include "ticket" + lease_epoch and that completion handler uses a single atomic read of prefix metadata to compare epoch+ticket. avoid per-batch roundtrips
Omar: for tombstones ill sketch encoding: eviction_gen (uint32) and tombstone_ts. hard-evict will bump eviction_gen and write tombstone = {gen, ts}. prefetch will abort if tombstone.gen > prefetch.gen. read path will check tombstone.gen cheaply as part of residency validity check
Priya: sticky_backoff idea: if a prefix sees >N prefetch rejects within T, delay completing handoff by sticky_backoff_s to reduce oscillation. add metric kv.prefetch.reject_burst_count to drive this
Ben: canary plan: pick 10 medium+hot prefixes from canary tenants, enable ticket_check + hybrid gen_mode, run continuous reads for 10m, trigger scripted handoffs every 30s for 5m, assert: no read gaps >100ms, kv.prefetch_ticket_rejects < 1% and prefetch duplicate-prefetch counter == 0
Liu: add tracing: prefetch:ticket, prefetch:result, evict:gen_before, evict:gen_after to make root-cause easy in console
Ana: config snippet for canary team:
```
kv.prefetch.ticket_check=true
kv.eviction.gen_mode=hybrid
kv.eviction.gen_hybrid_window_s=60
kv.handoff.sticky_backoff_s=30
kv.prefetch.reject_alert_pct=0.5
```
Omar: rollback plan (if perf or correctness regressions): 1) flip kv.prefetch.ticket_check=false 2) disable kv.eviction.gen_mode (set to none) 3) run cleanup job to remove any tombstone metadata left behind 4) rollback canary images
Priya: owners summary: Ana (prefetch ticket + metrics + traces), Omar (evict_gen hybrid + perf), Ben (tests + smoke harness + assertions), Liu (dashboards + alerts), Priya (canary coordination). please include rollback instructions in each PR description and tag me on PRs
Ben: i'll open umbrella issue and sub-issues, will assign and add checklist checkboxes
Ana: starting branch now. will ping infra for canary cluster once tests land
Priya: thanks all. we'll re-open if canary shows anomalies. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
